column3: MT 108:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. “Also my glory” is rendered “even with my soul.”
Close to the Hebrew; the second “peoples” is rendered “nations.”
Close to the Hebrew; “faithfulness” is rendered “truth,” and “clouds” as “skies.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB marks verses 7–9 as God’s speech, and “I will triumph” is rendered “I will exult.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the protection of my head” is rendered “the helmet of My head.”
Close to the Hebrew; “pot of washing” is rendered “washbowl,” and “sandal” as “shoe.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a city of fortification” is rendered “the besieged city.”
The Hebrew second line is a statement (“and you do not go out”); NASB makes it a question, “And will You not go forth …?”
Close to the Hebrew; “worthlessness” is rendered “in vain.”
Close to the Hebrew; “we will do strength” is rendered “we shall do valiantly.”
